title: Enabling Scalable Evaluation of Unfair Patterns in Medical LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures unfair patterns and biases in medical Large Language Models (LLMs) related to demographic attributes such as gender and race/ethnicity.
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
